raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-18 payments-source change, reversals arrive as separate REVERSAL rows (orig_txn_id points to the original), and the original stays POSTED. silver_transactions keeps only status='POSTED', so reversed originals are counted and gold totals run high. The fix is to exclude POSTED originals that a REVERSAL row references, matching the earlier REVERSED-status treatment, using a NULL-safe subquery.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) NOT IN (SELECT CAST(orig_txn_id AS BIGINT) FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL);"}}
